title: p4n4 template metadata (template.yaml)
description: Registry metadata for one template. The CLI reads it for `p4n4 template search/install`; scripts/validate.py checks it against the template's files.

name.description: Template id. Must equal the template's directory name.

version.description: Semantic version of the template. Bump it on every change.

layers.description: p4n4 layers the template provides. Must match .p4n4.json.

services.description: Every service in docker-compose.yml, in any order.

profile.description: Compose profile the service belongs to, if any.

data.description: Free-form description of the data contract (topics, buckets, archives). Shown by the CLI; not validated.

smoke_test.description: Executable, relative to the template directory, that tests the running template end to end. Exit 0 means pass.
